svg.title: BCM70015 fixed metadata publication comparison
svg.desc: Changed 72-byte metadata fingerprints between two non-atomic passes, for slots 0 through 33 in each trial and stage. First-output passes differ in 18 slots in A and 17 in B. One raw return write index zero is preserved without cause attribution. Whole outputs, EOS and cleanup pass; no current record, ARC completion, generation, extent or source lease is certified.

g.text: Fixed PPB metadata: publication during native delivery
Two H.264 trials · 256 × 96 · 180 frames each · 16 non-atomic snapshots
Metadata slots 0–33 · fingerprint of each fixed 72-byte prefix
Equal fingerprints, not a validity certificate
First-output raw ring words · D = delivery, R = return · read/write in hexadecimal
One raw R write index 0 is outside normal source indices 2–63; its cause is unattributed.
EOS and post-STOP: eight matching late snapshots; all four ring words 3b.
572 / 572 frames: whole-output controls, firmware EOS and cleanup passed.
Each observed trial: 784 reads / 22,208 B · max 72 B · residual payloads are not published
No current-record, ARC-completion, generation, extent or source-lease certification. No source-plane pointers followed.
